2607.11881.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
2607.11881.paper_summary: Metacognition is a foundational component of intelligence critical to effective learning, problem solving, decision-making, communication, and more. In recent years, it has become increasingly recognized as a cornerstone of capable, transparent AI systems. Yet while LLMs have made significant progress across diverse real-world tasks, it is not yet clear when, how, or to what extent they can exhibit or be endowed with effective metacognitive abilities, nor how such abilities can be adapted to advance the fundamental capabilities, reliability, and intelligence of AI systems. This paper bridges this gap by presenting the first comprehensive overview of the current state of knowledge on metacognition for LLMs. We analyze and taxonomize the landscape of this emerging field and summarize recent technical advancements, including methods and benchmarks to measure and evaluate LLMs' metacognitive abilities, techniques to elicit, improve, and apply metacognition in LLMs, and findings and implications of ongoing research. We also discuss applications, open questions and challenges, and promising directions for future work. Our aim is to provide a detailed and up-to-date review of this topic and stimulate meaningful research and discussion. An organized list of papers can be found at https://github.com/yale-nlp/LLM-Metacognition.
2607.11881.paper_summary_zh: 元認知是智力的基礎組成部分，對於有效的學習、問題解決、決策、溝通等至關重要。近年來，它越來越被認為是有能力且透明的人工智慧系統的基石。然而，儘管大型語言模型在多樣的現實世界任務中取得了顯著進展，但目前尚不清楚它們何時、如何或在多大程度上能夠展現或被賦予有效的元認知能力，以及這些能力如何能夠適應以提升人工智慧系統的基本能力、可靠性和智力。本文通過呈現有關大型語言模型元認知的當前知識狀態的首個綜合概述來填補這一空白。我們分析並對這一新興領域的格局進行分類，並總結近期的技術進展，包括測量和評估大型語言模型元認知能力的方法和基準、在大型語言模型中引發、改善和應用元認知的技術，以及正在進行的研究的發現和啟示。我們還討論了應用、未解決的問題和挑戰，以及未來工作的有希望方向。我們的目標是提供這一主題的詳細和最新的回顧，並激發有意義的研究和討論。組織好的論文列表可以在 https://github.com/yale-nlp/LLM-Metacognition 找到。
